title: Popconfirm
wrapsNative: MonarchPopover (androidx.compose.ui.window.Popup) anchored to a MonarchButton in a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Box, with MonarchText and a Cancel and a Danger MonarchButton in a androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row
summary: A recipe, not a component: a small confirmation anchored to the button that asked, with a question, a line of consequence, Cancel and a danger action that shows its progress.
whenToUse: For a light, reversible-in-practice action next to its button, such as removing a filter or a tag, where a full dialog would interrupt too much.
whenNotToUse: For destructive actions that cannot be undone, use AlertDialog (see confirm-dialog). For an action that can be undone, run it at once and offer Undo in a snackbar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchPopover(expanded: Boolean, onDismissRequest: () -> Unit, label: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, side: MonarchPopoverSide = MonarchPopoverSide.Bottom, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchButton(text: String, onClick: () -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, variant: MonarchButtonVariant = MonarchButtonVariant.Secondary, size: MonarchButtonSize = MonarchButtonSize.Md, enabled: Boolean = true, loading: Boolean = false, …)

states.name: asking
states.description: The popover under the button with the question, the consequence, Cancel and the danger action.

states.name: pending
states.description: The danger action shows its progress indicator and reads "Loading"; Cancel is disabled and a tap outside does not close it.

states.name: failed
states.description: Show the failure as a MonarchInlineNotice in the popover and keep it open.

appearance: MonarchPopover's raised surface with the default border and shadow; the question in the subheading style, the consequence in the muted text color, a small ghost Cancel and a small danger action. The same roles in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web Popconfirm is a component with a title, a description, confirm and cancel labels, a danger tone, a pending state while onConfirm runs, an error line and initial focus. On Android it is a recipe on MonarchPopover: the app holds the pending state and passes loading to the button. The plan's anchored popover keeps the question next to its button on every screen size; iOS uses the system confirmation dialog, which becomes a bottom sheet on a phone. initialFocus has no equivalent: TalkBack starts at the popover's label.
accessibility: MonarchPopover is named by its label (the question) and TalkBack moves into it when it opens; back closes it.
The question is a heading inside the popover.
The danger action is named by its text ("Remove"), so it does not depend on its color.
Both buttons have 48dp touch targets; the danger action reads "Loading" while pending.
edgeCases: Ignore onDismissRequest while the action runs, so a tap outside does not hide the progress.
Near the bottom of the screen, use MonarchPopoverSide.Top.

examples.title: Remove a filter
examples.setupTemplate:
var filters by remember { mutableStateOf(listOf({{filters.0}}, {{filters.1}})) }
var open by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>({{filters.0}}) }

var open by remember { mutableStateOf<String?>("Status: Open") }
